description: Existing exceptions to the front-end rules of tools/architecture-rules/frontend.mjs (docs/ENFORCEMENT.md, sections l to o). Measured on 31 October 2026; remove entries as they are fixed. Do not add entries without a reason.

jquery.reason: jqueryTrigger() is the one bridge that re-fires learner events as jQuery events for add-ons that still listen with .on(); it only runs when a theme or add-on loaded jQuery.
triggerLegacy() fires the legacy body events (added_to_cart, payment_method_selected, …) that gateway add-ons listen for; no-op without jQuery.
Gateway and cart add-ons receive the clicked button as a jQuery object in the legacy cart events; plain element without jQuery.
Classic payment gateway handlers' open( response, $form ) and resume( $form ) hooks receive a jQuery-wrapped form.
Listens for the legacy video tracker's jQuery event (ohmylms:video:completed) that add-on players still trigger.

featureImports.reason: The quiz settings and pools panels run in the native quiz editor: they use its assessment type control and lock post saving while pools are edited.
The pools editor lists and normalizes bank questions through the question bank's REST client and model.
The skill picker searches and creates curriculum skills; skillCurriculum.mjs reads the curriculum tree model.
The exam paper dialog typesets imported questions with the shared math loader.
Exam import, the paper dialog and the skill picker read and write bank questions through the question bank's REST client.
The native quiz sidebar renders the assessment settings panel.
The native quiz sidebar offers the Content Hub quiz export and import actions.
The native lesson and quiz editors mount the printable paper canvas, its blocks and inserter, and show placed questions in paper view.
Native question blocks and sidebars load, save and pick bank questions and edit their skill map.
The native editors host the shared question editor: its block, preview and the type models choiceAutosave validates before saving.
The rich content control inserts images with the question editor's media library opener.
The paper inserter offers the exam import and question import dialogs.
The paper canvas opens the learner preview of the quiz being edited.
Printed questions are typeset with the shared math loader.
The paper inserter adds bank questions with the bank picker.
Printed question types read the question models' public views (dropdown, interactive and puzzle layouts).
The bank model normalizes and validates questions with the question type models.
The multiple-choice block lists add-on question types from the native authoring manifest.
Question editors write statements, options and answers with the shared math and rich content controls.
The multiple-choice block follows paper view and offers the paper inserter on the printable exam.
Question editors use the bank model's type rules and the bank picker for the bank source.
